posts.title: Stripe Acquiring OpenRouter, Aggregating AI?, Flipping the Business Model
posts.summary: Stripe is reportedly acquiring OpenRouter, an implicit bet on a future market of models and the chance at Aggregation.
bullets: Stripe's reported acquisition of OpenRouter signals a strategic pivot toward becoming a central aggregator in the fragmented AI model market.
By controlling the infrastructure layer for AI model access, Stripe aims to capture value from the increasing commoditization of LLMs.
This move represents a fundamental shift in Stripe's business model, moving beyond pure payment processing to owning the underlying utility layer for AI-driven applications.

The acquisition positions Stripe to benefit from the 'Aggregation Theory' by reducing friction for developers to switch between various AI providers, thereby cementing Stripe's role as the essential platform for the digital economy.

posts.title: 800VDC Pushes AI Power Design From Grid To Gate
posts.summary:
The next power bottleneck is no longer just inside the accelerator — it is the full conversion path from medium-voltage AC to sub-1V silicon.
The post 800VDC Pushes AI Power Design From Grid To Gate appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: AI data center power requirements are shifting from 125kW to 500kW and eventually 1MW, necessitating a transition to 800VDC architectures to manage efficiency.
The industry is moving away from traditional multi-stage power conversion toward streamlined architectures that reduce energy loss between the medium-voltage grid and sub-1V GPU rails.
Hyperscalers are increasingly adopting solid-state transformers to minimize conversion stages, which is forcing component suppliers to fundamentally rethink power electronics design.
Thermal management and power density have become primary bottlenecks, as the efficiency of the entire conversion path directly impacts the performance and reliability of AI accelerators.

posts.title: Geely Auto lifts export goal to 920,000 as overseas becomes only growth engine
posts.summary:
The new target represents nearly 120% growth from 2025 exports, with the company targeting a combined 1,000,000-vehicle scale across 5 key overseas markets.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely Auto has aggressively raised its 2026 export target to 920,000 vehicles, a 44% increase from its original guidance and nearly double the 2025 export volume.
Overseas markets have become the company's primary growth engine, as domestic sales in China declined 22.6% during the first half of the year.
New energy vehicles (NEVs) are driving this international expansion, accounting for 59% of total exports in July with a 616% year-on-year growth rate.

posts.title: CATL says core operations carbon neutral by end-2025, supply chain next
posts.summary:
CATL said its supply chain accounts for more than 80% of its products' carbon emissions, and it aims to achieve value-chain carbon neutrality by 2035.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: CATL has achieved carbon neutrality across its core operations by the end of 2025, utilizing 100% zero-carbon electricity across its manufacturing bases.
The company has set a new goal to achieve value-chain carbon neutrality by 2035, a significant challenge given that over 80% of product emissions originate from the supply chain.
To manage this transition, CATL has implemented a full-chain carbon data traceability platform to monitor emissions from mineral extraction through component manufacturing.
